PRD — "Workspace Templates v1":
Add a template gallery to workspace creation. Users can pick from 8 starter templates (marketing, sales, eng sprint, etc.) instead of starting blank. Templates pre-populate boards, fields, and sample data. Requirements: gallery screen with preview, template application flow, admin ability to publish org-specific templates, and template analytics. Engineering estimates 6 weeks. Target ship: end of Q3.
